release_notes: Added a new Scratchpad/Notepad mode for free Morse writing. Users can open a separate window and copy arbitrary text without starting a practice round or saving the copied text to the database.

Scratchpad uses live adaptive Morse decoding, supports editable text with undo/copy/select-all shortcuts, automatic word wrapping, scrolling, session-only statistics and a compact raw telemetry visualization.
Scratchpad window geometry and raw telemetry visibility are saved per profile, while the copied text and session data remain in memory only.
Improved Morse input routing so Scratchpad, Network, Koch and normal practice modes do not compete for the same key input.
Added Scratchpad translations and help content for all supported languages.
Includes fixes for Scratchpad duplicate text insertion, raw telemetry display and WPM calculations during idle time.
